ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central regions) to low-intensity black pixels (edges and central column).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity zones in the interior of both lobes; continuous black low-intensity boundary along the trailing edge and tips; thick black vertical column at the median notch junction; high-frequency black speckling/mottling at the boundaries between white and black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45-55 degrees, showing significant penetration into the fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5-15 pixels in amplitude relative to the primary contour; jaggedness is more pronounced on the right lobe (viewer-left).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve tapering towards acute, posteriorly-oriented tips; trailing edge transitions from a shallow curve to a sharp points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered low-intensity circular pixel clusters (mottling) distributed throughout the white high-intensity fields, with a higher density near the peduncle junction and lower interior edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark horizontal linear streak located on the viewer-left lobe; several fine, vertically oriented linear markings on the viewer-right lobe extending upwards from the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable yellow-hued irregular patch (diatom or lesion) on the white region of the viewer-left lobe; significant irregular notch/loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the viewer-right lobe near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown bio-pigmentation patches contrasting against the white high-intensity ventral background on the viewer-left lobe.
